verdict.rationale: dlt explicitly supports local, lightweight testing via DuckDB destination (`pip install dlt[duckdb]`) and the tutorial walks through running/inspecting a pipeline locally before switching destinations without code changes, which is the standard path to production. Community feedback corroborates ease of local use and simplicity for everyday ETL tasks. Missing for 10: explicit guidance on 'testing' semantics (assertions/CI) beyond inspection, and independent hands-on verification of switching from local DuckDB to a production destination.
